title: Fire in the Hole (Geometry Dash)
blurb: Delivered with such deranged conviction that it stopped meaning anything about explosives some time ago. The clip travelled out of Geometry Dash and into the wider brainrot canon, where it now simply means chaos is imminent and somebody has chosen it deliberately. Gen Alpha adopted it as a battle cry, complete with the shouting-emoji spelling. Play it before any reckless action: queueing ranked at midnight, texting first, opening the family group chat after a wedding. The hole is entirely metaphorical. The fire, regrettably, is not.
origin: From Geometry Dash's lobby sounds, resurrected as a brainrot meme.
